owner_requirement: Future exercise expansion with permanently identifiable group/member taxonomy; muscle highlight appearance undecided and NOT implemented

notes: Proposed categories include some variable/optional anatomy and grouped segments. All proposed IDs require independent anatomical review and registry acceptance before becoming immutable published IDs.
Midline/unpaired or segmental muscles may require a nonbilateral convention at approval; two sides here are planning placeholders only.
Existing thenar_group and interossei_lumbricals_group are aggregate seeds, not individually validated muscles; new proposed individual hand records do not overwrite them.
Exact origin/insertion bone-local coordinates, wrapping, fascia relationships, realistic soft tissue volumes and side mappings remain unresolved.
Functional-group membership is an indicative list for future exercise authoring only, NOT a claim that all members are active in a specific task or that these lists exhaust human anatomy.
